description: Opens a teleprompter with the script loaded, ready to read while the camera records. In chat apps that show app views it appears right in the chat; it also returns a link to the full teleprompter page. Use it when the user wants to read, rehearse or record a script, speech, pitch or video. Pass the full script as plain spoken text with an empty line between paragraphs, no markdown or stage directions.

script.description: The full script, plain text, paragraphs separated by an empty line.

name: open_in_teleprompter
title: Open in teleprompter
